steps.message:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-16, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

The resistivity values for the layers are:
- Layer 1: 312.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 2: 794.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 3: 884.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 4: 1280.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 5: 4929.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

Following the curve-type notation for $N=5$ layers (which results in $5-2=3$ letters):
1. For layers 1-2-3: $312.0 < 794.3 < 884.4 \implies \text{A}$
2. For layers 2-3-4: $794.3 < 884.4 < 1280.2 \implies \text{A}$
3. For layers 3-4-5: $884.4 < 1280.2 < 4929.0 \implies \text{A}$

The sequence of letters is AAA. According to the rule, if all letters are the same, the curve can be written as the single letter A.

{"curve_type": "A"}
